acceptedForwardReversionProposal.sourceBinding: exact accepted forward release, its actual current container and CAS generation
acceptedForwardReversionProposal.targetBinding: only the exact reversion image and original application revision above
acceptedForwardReversionProposal.inheritFrom: accepted forward proof and live state, never old environment or old database snapshots
preserve: all current erasure fences and in-progress durable jobs
all mounts, networks and security options
requiredChecks: image configuration equality except revision label
no database migration or schema downgrade
current provider readiness and fence continuity
fresh pre/post health and anonymous authorization denial
acceptedForwardReversionProposal.expectedFeatureEffect: user-selected arrival capability disappears; new arrival requests fail closed; no automatic alternative or access relaxation

pendingForwardReversionProposal.reason: normal prepare refuses pending activation and guarded recover rollback is explicitly denied
pendingForwardReversionProposal.wouldRequire: separate bounded pending-state reversion implementation and approval, including a fresh reverse binding and preserved pending history

recoverOnlyRiskIfForwardProceedingWithou: If failure happens after target start but before accepted pointer commit, old-image restoration is not available through existing guards. The pending checkpoint is retained and the same approved target must be recovered, or a separate precisely reviewed repair must be prepared. COP may be unavailable or degraded meanwhile; no guaranteed recovery duration is established.
